title: Daisy's house-training mediation model
content: Figure 9.6 separates a direct Other Pets -> House Training hypothesis from an indirect Other Pets -> Crating/Supervision -> House Training hypothesis. The attempted nested-counterfactual experiment was inconclusive, so the graph carries no manufactured outcome value.

variables.name: Other Pets
variables.content: The presence or absence of foster kittens.

variables.name: Crating/Supervision
variables.content: The mediator changed when kittens were present.

arrows.because: Kittens caused Daisy to be crated or supervised more closely.
Crating and supervision could mediate improved house training.
Figure 9.6 retains the direct pack-psychology hypothesis.
